assumptions: Only expired-unconfirmed merged claims qualify; active and relinquished merged claims refuse.
Original source/merge/objects/reservations and prior refusals remain immutable.
Independent abandonment audit, current chat authorization, clean successor and no stages/conflicts remain required.
Ordinary manager bytes remain unchanged; separate explicit expired-MERGED CLI imports canonical primitives.
goal: Guarded operator adoption for expired merged-stranded author claims without an active-lease override.
prohibited_actions: No live claim adoption, schema writes, preview, merge or production.
No active-lease override, reviewer replacement or erased substantive refusal.
stop_conditions: Stop if the exact claim, PR, version reservation, audit, chat marker, or operator attestation cannot be proved
Stop if a target worktree identity collides or the immutable adoption record cannot be read back
Stop before any live claim transfer pending a separate exact owner decision
